status: Secondary probability scoring and descriptive sensitivity rules fixed while inference running, before new score tables.
probability: Native common q.1..q.9 unchanged. Pinball mean of9marginal losses. Interval score=(upper-lower)+10*max(lower-y,0)+10*max(y-upper,0). WIS=(.5*abs(y-median)+.1*interval_score)/1.5, divided by preyear scale. Crossings retained; invalid interval makes its full aggregate undefined. No fitting/calibration/selection.
uncertainty: Year-specific and leave-one-family-out composition sensitivity only; no independent-row tests, no bootstrap claiming precise generality from two event years.
